question: Does the stored-weight exact unit-mode phenomenon in Run 137 persist under matched-initialization float64 training and an independently parameterized 3-state ReLU RNN?
comparative_legacy_architecture: 2-state ReLU RNN, matched float32 initialization, train independently in float32 and float64
prospective_architecture: 3-state ReLU RNN, independently parameterized A(3x3), E(3x3), w(3), matched initial float32 tensors; train independently in float32 and float64
train: ordinary output MSE at each prefix of all 3^6 six-token sequences; Adam 1200 steps lr=0.025; no hidden-state objective or projection; CPU only
exact_plus_ray_eligibility: For coordinate j: Eplus[j]>0, Eplus[k]<=0 and A[k,j]<=0 for every k!=j, A[j,j]==1 exactly as stored binary float; this implies h(+^n)=n Eplus[j] e_j. Require w[j]*Eplus[j] not equal 1 for delayed output drift classification.
primary_endpoint: Count exact-plus-ray eligible checkpoints among float64 legacy 2D and float32/float64 fresh 3D; test whether all three Run137 legacy seeds retain eligibility under float64 with same initial tensors.
falsification: If any matched float64 legacy seed lacks exact unit A[j,j], Run137 exact-unit mode is not precision-stable. If all three persist, the simple numerical-rounding explanation is weakened.
independent_checker: Use Python Fraction.from_float for stored coefficients, independently test all eligibility inequalities and n=0,1,2,3 plus-only exact rational trajectories. Verify primary count from raw parameter arrays.
publishable_threshold: A spoof-resistant output-coupled certificate prospectively tracking gradient-trained algorithm acquisition in an unseen architecture and task; this experiment alone cannot establish it.
learning_relevance_threshold: Ordinary gradient training modifies all A/E/w and independently assessed plus/return length-256 generalization; compare exact mode across precision and 3D architecture.
kill_condition: If precision-stability fails, kill exact binary32-equality as evidence of robust algorithm acquisition and reformulate around quantitative approximate invariants with calibrated finite-horizon prediction; no third unsupported positive claim.
compute: local cloud CPU only; zero personal spend
